trap-nonspeakable.notes: pass. TWO SEPARATE MATH FINDINGS, not fixed inline (math-adjacent, structural). (1) SYMBOL COLLISION on tau: the opening sentence writes the QOU triple as (C, A, tau) — tau is the fibre functor per the notation register — and in the very next sentence uses tau(r_i,s_i) for the embeddable torus knots, then tau_lambda and beta(tau_lambda) in (ii) and (iv). Two meanings of tau one sentence apart. Proposed: rename the knot family to K(r_i,s_i) / K_lambda, or use the corpus's T_{r,s}. (2) The clause-(i) identity Phi = sum_lambda d_lambda(q) Phi_lambda is false as written given the block's own definition Phi_lambda = e_lambda Phi e_lambda: the e_lambda are the central idempotents of the Wedderburn decomposition, so sum_lambda e_lambda = 1 and Phi = sum_lambda Phi_lambda with NO d_lambda weight. The quantum dimension belongs in the trace of clause (ii) (Markov trace = sum_lambda w_lambda chi_lambda), not in the operator decomposition.
